items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: He was a promoter all the way. He started the first Gasworks here

ctx.x: Well I'll get in that class just spoke on the heavyweight championship and show if he was involved in some, I think a heavyweight championship match with an English rocker who he imported. I'll have to look it up.

He was a promoter all the way. He started the first Gasworks here, and he was in other business ventures, which went up and down, and the theater to him was another such venture, although I think his heart was always more in the theater. He'd started himself in an English company that he brought here in it was either 1817, I think it was 1817, and rented a little decrepit theater on St. Philip Street.

Well you hear about it later so much, playing between rounds is something I can't imagine happening today, but certainly within the memory of living people. I played between rounds. You played between rounds, right? Where?
